correctness.rationale: The type-to-insertion-gap bijection is exact. For each fixed k the parity and symmetric-difference constraints embed all grade-k cells in an (n-k+1)-by-(k+1) rectangle. The explicitly defined folded permutation is bijective by value-parity partition and gives exact prefix intersections (i+j-k)/2 throughout that rectangle. The row-walk intermediate-value argument gives 2(k+1) grade-k cells for k <= n/2, with an extra endpoint count at the overlap n=2k; reversing the second order proves the other half. Increasing and decreasing permutations attain every lower bound. Complete enumeration through n=9 and separate folded checks through n=80 support, but do not substitute for, the proof.

originality.rationale: The full all-grade coefficient envelope and explicit parity-folded maximizer were compared against Cameron 2002, Linman–Pinsker 2014, accessible research record claims, and actual targeted semantic and web searches. Existing exact all-grade expectations and sharp grade-one and grade-two bounds are acknowledged as covered special cases, not originality. A sharp construction at arbitrary intermediate grade and the lower envelope were not established by these sources. Historical equivalence is a residual risk, so this is best-knowledge originality rather than a uniqueness certificate.

value.rationale: The count c_k is a canonical logical statistic for a fresh point in two linearly ordered structures, recording exactly the parameters where its two order comparisons differ. Uniform sharp bounds and constructive extremizers at every grade give a mathematically motivated global type-spectrum result beyond previously treated grades one and two. The central coefficient can vary by a factor linear in the number of parameters despite the total number of types being fixed.
